extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, first appointment listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor seeks around £31,500 to fund his client's financial remedy proceedings at Bristol Family Court, where matrimonial assets are about £328,000 and the first appointment is listed for 21 November 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we will need confirmation of your client's identity and address, details of the matrimonial assets including valuations of the family home and pension, confirmation of any mortgage or other charges, and a costs estimate broken down by stage. It would also help to have an indication of your client's current income and any existing funding arrangements, together with details of the other party's position. Please note that this message is an acknowledgement only and does not constitute an offer or any indication of terms. A member of our team will be in touch once the information has been reviewed.
